bit_waveform.strobing: re-strobe on the falling edge at the start of each Byte Start Sequence (BSS).
bit_waveform.note: No bit stuffing; no separate clock wire.

frame_waveform.framing: TSS + FSS + (per-byte BSS + 8 data bits) ... + FES
frame_waveform.header: 5 bytes: indicator bits + Frame ID (11) + Payload Length (7) + Header CRC (11) + Cycle Count (6).

communication_cycle_waveform.static_segment: Equal-length static slots in macroticks; one sender per slot per channel.
communication_cycle_waveform.dynamic_segment: Minislots; counter holds during a transmitted frame, advances on an empty minislot.
communication_cycle_waveform.nit: Communication-free; clock-sync calculation + offset correction applied.

clock_sync_waveform.offset_correction: phase correction computed in the NIT and applied at cycle end.
clock_sync_waveform.rate_correction: frequency correction computed over an even/odd cycle pair, applied gradually.
clock_sync_waveform.algorithm: Fault-Tolerant Midpoint over received sync frames.

startup_waveform.wakeup: Wakeup Pattern (WUP) = repeated Wakeup Symbols (WUS), one channel at a time.
startup_waveform.coldstart: Leading coldstart node sends CAS then startup frames; followers integrate over several cycles; >=2 coldstart nodes agree.

general_timing_rule: All slot and segment boundaries are fixed in macroticks and identical cluster-wide. The macrotick is an integer number of microticks adjusted by rate correction so it has the same duration in every node. Bit time is 100 ns at 10 Mbit/s; the receiver oversamples 8x and re-strobes per byte.

voltage_levels.modulation: differential NRZ; idle/recessive vs Data_0 / Data_1.
voltage_levels.termination: differential bus termination per the FlexRay electrical physical layer.
